grading_policy: Count edits in the full sentence. Useful feedback requires a correct complete correction, no unnecessary edits, preserved meaning and an accurate explanation stating the applicable rule. Generic suggestions without the applicable rule fail explanation adequacy. The project owner approved this threshold on 2026-09-30. Wording preferences alone do not fail accuracy.
note: explanation_accurate requires both accuracy and sufficient explanation of the applicable rule. Missing/generic explanations fail adequacy. Empty output on valid English needs no explanation. Rejected outputs remain misses.
